text:
Devon: Heads up — overnight we had a spike of 30x GPU OOM alerts in us-west1-preemptible pool at 02:14. Many were duplicates, paging the oncall. I think we should experiment with a two-tier rule: page on sustained >=3 hosts failing in 5m OR any host with repeated OOMs >10 in 10m; otherwise create a ticket. Thoughts?

Ben: Saw that, looked like churn from preemptible evictions + runaway jobs. Paging was noisy. +1 for two-tier.

Alice: Curious — what's our current rule? I think it pages on >1 OOM in 5m which is too sensitive for preemptibles.

Devon: Current: prometheus alert `gpu_oom_rate` alerts if count_over_time(oom[5m]) > 1 per node and groups by cluster. Triggers page.

Cara: Can we add grouping by node pool + host and set `for: 10m` for page? Then ticket for shorter 'for' or lower severity.

Devon: Proposal: create `gpu_oom_page` with `for: 5m` and condition: sum by (node_pool) (increase(oom_total[5m])) >=3 AND max by (node) (increase(oom_total[10m])) > 10. Otherwise `gpu_oom_ticket` fires: sum >=1. I'll paste example.

Devon: ```yaml
- alert: GPUOOMPage
  expr: sum by(node_pool)(increase(oom_total[5m])) >= 3 and max by(node)(increase(oom_total[10m])) > 10
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
- alert: GPUOOMTicket
  expr: sum by(node_pool)(increase(oom_total[5m])) >= 1
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
```

Ben: We should also add mute window 00:00-06:00 for preemptible pools to avoid waking on transient night jobs. But ensure SLO dashboards capture aggregated error-rate.

Alice: fine with mute ✅ but add a pager escalation if error-rate crosses SLO of 0.5% across cluster for 15m.

Devon: I'll run a canary: change in dev cluster then us-west1-staging for 24h and measure noise reduction (alerts reduced by target 60%). I'll update runbook and dashboard panels: add an 'alert noise' Grafana panel.

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: plan/1234. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/gpu-oom

Cara: Also add grouping key `node_pool` + `region` so we don't page for a single noisy host in a huge pool.

Ben: +1. If this reduces pages we can roll to prod next week.

Devon: Thanks. I'll post follow-up with numbers. @oncall please ack if you see noisy pages tonight and ping if anything slips.
